headlines.snippet: At least 17 people have died in a devastating flash flood on the Nepal-China border, with hundreds of trekkers missing and significant destruction. Massive water flows swept through northern Nepal, causing buildings to collapse into the river. Rescue efforts are hampered by high water levels, and Tibet also reported casualties and infrastructure damage. The flood was likely triggered by a landslide that dammed the river, and its subsequent release caused the inundation. Among the missing are 291 foreign nationals and 93 Nepalis, along with 60 workers from a hydroelectric power station.
